title: Minerva - Minerva Lore & Dialogue
blurb: Who Minerva is, her own story, her bodyguard Tommy Ten-Toes, where she sets up, and every line she says.

sections.title: Who Is Minerva?
sections.html:
Minerva is the Blue Ridge Caravan Company's travelling plan merchant. She sells hand-drawn "recreations" of rare plans and recipes at a discount, and she only stays in one place for a short time before moving on.

{img:minerva-caravan.avif}

Her story, in her own words

"Been with 'em since I was pint sized brainy brat. I'm originally from DC. Survived the bombs thanks to my local library seconding as a bomb shelter. Wound up wandering from group to group, until my talents caught the eye of some Blue Ridge folk passing through. Ended up being an apprentice for a book salesman, rewriting books by hand. He was a dear friend and great mentor. After he passed, I took over his caravan. Switched from books to something a little more catered for the modern survivor's needs, though. But Blue Ridge are my business partners and my family... And I couldn't ask for a better one."

The human copying machine

She has a photographic memory: "If I've seen it, I can picture it, and draw it exactly so." Everything she sells is drawn from memory, which is also why her stock keeps changing ("I can only draw so much before my wrist snaps in two. Not many treatments for carpal tunnel syndrome in the Wasteland").

Ask whether it's a waste of her talent and she's blunt: "Turning a profit is all I know, and I ever want to know."

Tommy Ten-Toes and Minos

Tommy Ten-Toes is her ghoul bodyguard. He's quick to point out he works for Blue Ridge, not Minerva, "but seeing as I only ever gets paired wit Minerva, I guess it don' make much difference." They used to call him Tommy the Nose; now it's Ten-Toes "on accounts of my ten toes... on the one foot" (fifteen in total, he works out). He misses zoos, loves rhinoceroses, and something happened "in Chattanooga. That poor lil' doggie..."

Minerva's take on him: "He may seem intimidating, but he's a big goofy teddy bear... Try and steal something, though, and he will rip your sternum out. I've seen him do it."

Her brahmin is called Minos.

She first appeared in the Steel Reign update, and the Fallout Wiki credits Erikka J. Veney as her voice.

sections.title: Where to Find Her
sections.html:
Minerva, Tommy and Minos are placed at four spots, and only one is switched on at a time: Foundation, The Crater, Fort Atlas and The Whitespring Resort. She has her own shout-out lines for The Crater, Foundation and Fort Atlas.

See Minerva's Lists for what she sells on each visit, and the Gold Bullion Calculator.

groups.title: Talking to Minerva and Tommy Ten-Toes

items.prompt: What sort of things do you sell here?
lines: You'd think with all the carnival barking I do, I wouldn't get this question much. But alas, here I go answering it again.
My caravan sells recreations of all sorts of rare plans and recipes, at discounted prices no less.
I've got what you'd call... a photographic memory. If I've seen it, I can picture it, and draw it exactly so.
"The human copying machine," they say, but I suspect that name will lose its veneer once anyone that remembers copying machines has died off.
If you're interested in plans at unbeatable prices, I'm the best that the Blue Ridge Caravan Company has.

items.prompt: How long will you be here?
lines: Not long. So if you've got your eye on something act fast.
My stock is constantly rotating with new and exciting observations from my travels.
But that also means you're unlikely to see the same thing on back to back visits, so grab what you can while I'm here.

items.prompt: What's with the big Ghoul in the hat?
lines: Tommy? Well it wouldn't be a caravan without someone riding shotgun. He may seem intimidating, but he's a big goofy teddy bear.
Loves to chat, so say hi.
Try and steal something, though, and he will rip your sternum out. I've seen him do it. Very graphic.

items.prompt: Let me see what's in stock.
lines: Drum roll, please...
Mmhmm. But don't forget, I won't be around here forever. Make sure you grab the goods you want before they're gone!

items.prompt: A photographic memory? Isn't this a waste of your talent?
lines: And what else could I be spending my talent on, pray tell? Turning a profit is all I know, and I ever want to know.

items.prompt: You're with the Blue Ridge Caravan Company?
lines: Sure am. Been with 'em since I was pint sized brainy brat.
I'm originally from DC. Survived the bombs thanks to my local library seconding as a bomb shelter.
Wound up wandering from group to group, until my talents caught the eye of some Blue Ridge folk passing through.
Ended up being an apprentice for a book salesman, rewriting books by hand. He was a dear friend and great mentor.
After he passed, I took over his caravan. Switched from books to something a little more catered for the modern survivor's needs, though.
But Blue Ridge are my business partners and my family... And I couldn't ask for a better one.

items.prompt: Thanks, that's all I wanted to know.
lines: Sure thing.

items.prompt: I thought you make all this from memory. Why can't you just offer everything all the time?
lines: My mind may be unending, but I can only draw so much before my wrist snaps in two.
Not many treatments for carpal tunnel syndrome in the Wasteland, you know.

items.prompt: Okay then, let me take a look at your stock.
lines: Now, that's a smart move.

items.prompt: I wanted to ask about something else.
lines: What else did you want to know?

items.prompt: How's life as a caravan guard?
lines: Oh you know. None too bad, none too good.
A lot of walkin'. A bit of shootin'. Mostly just standin' around, trying ta look all intimadatin' like.

items.prompt: How did you get your name?
lines: Well, they call me Tommy Ten-Toes on accounts of my ten toes... on the one foot.
They used to call me Tommy the Nose. Pretty sure it's 'cause I nose a lot. I nose about business, I nose about guns. I nose it all.
But, uh, after getting all Ghouly they stopped calling me the nose... Maybe they don't think I nose it like I used to.
But, I got these toes, though. More than I can count! Oh wait, fifteen. Fifteen toes. See? Tommy still nose.

items.prompt: What's it like working for Minerva?
lines: To be clear: Tommy don' work for Minerva. Tommy works for the Blue Ridge Caravan Company.
But... seeing as I only ever gets paired wit Minerva, I guess it don' make much difference.
Anyways, she's all right. You know that she draws them pictures of guns and stuff herself right? And people are actually buyin' em?
Maybe I should sell some drawins too. I draw animals real good. Like dem kangaroos. Oh, and rhinoceroses.
I love rhinoceroses... Ya ever been ta the zoo? I miss zoos.
Another time then, okay.

items.prompt: Hold on a second, ten toes... on one foot?
lines: Oh yeah. You wanna see 'em? Oh, sorry, Minerva said I can't be takin' my shoes off in front of customers no more.
Especially afta' what happened in Chattanooga. That poor lil' doggie...
Hey, any time, pally.
Yeah, I thought so. You look like the zoo type. Got it right again, Tommy.
See, that's too bad. Not enough zoos these days. People are bein' deprived I tells ya.

loose.label: Greeting (when you start talking)
loose.quest: Talking to Minerva and Tommy Ten-Toes

lines: Always happy to chat with a customer. What do you need?
Couldn't resist, could you? Well, it's no surprise, there's few that can match my prices.
Minerva, at your service. Looking for some weaponry schematics? Maybe a pattern for a swanky new set of armor?
Aha, you could have gone to any old merchant, but you, my friend, have that special refined taste. Very nice.
Won't be around forever, so make sure you snag any deals that pique your interests.

loose.label: Idle chatter
loose.quest: Talking to Minerva and Tommy Ten-Toes

lines: I sell plans, schematics, and recipes supreme. From weapons to armors, and all things between.
Drawn from my memory: a human copying machine. All found at prices that you've never seen!
Welcome! Don't be shy. I won't be around for long, so browse while you can.
Why pay full price when you can buy my recreations at a discount?
Behold! Picture perfect copies of plans and recipes! Hand-drawn from my photographic memory, you'd never know these weren't the real thing!
My photographic memory allows me to share plans from far and wide at prices that can't be beat!
Every schematic and recipe recreated to perfection. Satisfaction guaranteed!
See a plan that strikes your fancy? Better pick it up today. My stock is constantly changing, so you might not live to see the same plan twice!
Come browse my wares, from exotic to rare, my inventory's legendary, but my prices are fair!
To all my Raiders of the Crater, lay down your arms and pick up these hot deals!
Hello, Crater! These prices are so good, it's practically robbery! So, please, don't actually rob me...
People of Foundation, I come bearing tidings of low prices! No need to shop around, "settle" on these bargains today!
My travels take me far and wide. Today Foundation, but maybe next time I'll be in the Crater. In other words... Buy something while you can!
Nothing says "Ad Victoriam" like great prices and rare finds! Fall in for steep savings, Brothers!
You don't need to be a Scribe to see these schematics are the real deal! Shop for firepower to take back Appalachia!
Friends and patrons, today is the day. Minerva's store has returned, so don't delay
With plans for weapons to keep baddies at bay. Shop while you can for this caravan won't stay!
Hello, Appalachia! My name's Minerva, my game's hand-crafted replications of the rarest plans and recipes!
Every component and mechanism, recreated precisely to a fraction of a hundredth of a millimeter!
Shop while you can, I won't be here long! And if you don't see something you're interested in, I'll have a different assortment next time I'm in town.
